definitions.explanation: The winner of a competition or tournament, especially in sports. Also used for the current holder of a championship title.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{三年|さんねん}{連続|れんぞく}でチャンピオンに{輝|かがや}いた。
examples.english: He won the championship for three consecutive years.

examples.japanese: {世界|せかい}チャンピオンの{座|ざ}を{懸|か}けた{試合|しあい}が、{来週|らいしゅう}{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: The match for the world championship title will be held next week.

notes:
チャンピオン refers to the winner or title holder in a competition, especially in sports such as boxing, wrestling, and other fighting disciplines. From English "champion."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チャンピオンになる: to become champion
- チャンピオンに{輝|かがや}く: to win the championship (literary)
- チャンピオンを{目指|めざ}す: to aim for the championship
- チャンピオンを{防衛|ぼうえい}する: to defend a championship title

COMPOUNDS:
- {世界|せかい}チャンピオン: world champion
- チャンピオンベルト: championship belt
- チャンピオン{大会|たいかい}: championship tournament

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {優勝者|ゆうしょうしゃ}: winner, champion (native Japanese equivalent)
- {王者|おうじゃ}: champion, king (literary, used for dominant figures)
